# Nimbuz CLI — Command Reference

Complete reference for `@nimbuz/cli` v1.0.0. Every command, argument and flag below is generated from the
same registry that powers `nimbuz --help`, so it is always accurate for this version.

## Global flags

These flags work with every command.

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-p, --project <id\|name>` | Project to use (overrides the current context) |
| `-E, --env <id\|name>` | Environment to use (overrides the current context) |
| `--json` | Print machine-readable JSON |
| `-q, --quiet` | Only print essential output (IDs/names) |
| `-y, --yes` | Skip confirmation prompts |
| `--profile <name>` | Config profile to use |
| `--debug` | Log HTTP requests to stderr |
| `-h, --help` | Show help |

## Commands

### `nimbuz login`

Log in with your Nimbuz credentials and save the session locally. Supports two-factor authentication.

```text
nimbuz login [flags]
```

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-u, --username <email>` | Username / e-mail |
| `--org <name>` | Business organization name (individual accounts: nimbuz) |
| `--individual` | Log in to an individual account (org = nimbuz) |
| `--password-stdin` | Read the password from stdin (also: NIMBUZ_PASSWORD) |
| `--code <123456>` | 2FA code, if two-factor authentication is enabled |
| `--token <jwt>` | Save an existing access token instead of logging in |

```bash
nimbuz login
nimbuz login --individual -u jane@example.com
nimbuz login --org acme -u jane@acme.com
# CI: read the password from a secret
echo "$NIMBUZ_PASSWORD" | nimbuz login --org acme -u ci@acme.com --password-stdin
```

### `nimbuz use`

Remember a project (and environment) so later commands don't need --project/--env.

```text
nimbuz use [project] [environment] [flags]
```

| Argument | Description | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `project` | Project name or ID | no |
| `environment` | Environment name or ID (defaults to the only one, or prompts) | no |

```bash
nimbuz use shop-api production
nimbuz use            # pick interactively
```

### `nimbuz init`

Detects your Git remote, branch and runtime, and writes a nimbuz.json manifest used by `nimbuz deploy`.

```text
nimbuz init [flags]
```

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-f, --file <path>` | Manifest path (default: nimbuz.json) |
| `--force` | Overwrite an existing manifest |

---

### `nimbuz deploy`

Deploys the app described by ./nimbuz.json (or flags). Creates the app if it does not exist,
otherwise rolls out the new configuration, then waits for the rollout to finish.

With no manifest and no --repo, the current folder's git remote and branch are used.
Manifest values like "${VAR}" are read from your shell — handy for CI secrets.

```text
nimbuz deploy [name] [flags]
```

| Argument | Description | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | App name (default: from manifest or folder) | no |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-r, --repo <url\|owner/repo>` | Git repository (GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket) |
| `-b, --branch <name>` | Git branch (default: main) |
| `--archive <path>` | Deploy a local .zip/.tar archive instead of Git |
| `--dir <path>` | Sub-folder of the repository to build |
| `--dockerfile <file>` | Dockerfile name (default: auto-detect) |
| `--auto-deploy` | Redeploy automatically on every push |
| `-i, --instance <type>` | Instance type, e.g. nano.m, small.m (see `nimbuz billing pricing`) |
| `--replicas <n>` | Number of replicas |
| `--autoscale <min:max>` | Enable autoscaling between min and max replicas ("off" to disable) |
| `--install-cmd <cmd>` | Install command (e.g. npm ci) |
| `--build-cmd <cmd>` | Build command |
| `--start-cmd <cmd>` | Start command |
| `--port <n>` | Container port |
| `--health <path>` | Health-check path, e.g. /health |
| `--storage <size>` | Persistent volume size, e.g. 1Gi |
| `-e, --env-var <KEY=VALUE> …` | Environment variable (repeatable) |
| `--env-file <path>` | Load environment variables from a .env file |
| `-s, --secret <KEY=VALUE> …` | Secret variable (repeatable) |
| `--secret-file <path>` | Load secrets from a .env file |
| `--config-file <local[:mount]>` | Mount a local file into the container (e.g. ./app.yaml:/app/config/app.yaml) |
| `-f, --file <path>` | Read settings from a manifest (default: ./nimbuz.json for deploy) |
| `-w, --wait` | Wait for the rollout (--no-wait to return immediately) |

```bash
nimbuz deploy
nimbuz deploy --env staging --branch develop
nimbuz deploy shop-api --repo acme/shop-api -i medium.m -e NODE_ENV=production
nimbuz deploy -f deploy/nimbuz.prod.json --no-wait
```

#### `nimbuz projects create`


| Argument | Description | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-d, --description <value>` | Description (max 200 chars) |

#### `nimbuz apps create`

Create an app from Git or an archive

**Aliases:** `new`

```text
nimbuz apps create [name] [flags]
```

| Argument | Description | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | App name (3-40 lowercase letters, digits, dashes) | no |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-r, --repo <url\|owner/repo>` | Git repository (GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket) |
| `-b, --branch <name>` | Git branch (default: main) |
| `--archive <path>` | Deploy a local .zip/.tar archive instead of Git |
| `--dir <path>` | Sub-folder of the repository to build |
| `--dockerfile <file>` | Dockerfile name (default: auto-detect) |
| `--auto-deploy` | Redeploy automatically on every push |
| `-i, --instance <type>` | Instance type, e.g. nano.m, small.m (see `nimbuz billing pricing`) |
| `--replicas <n>` | Number of replicas |
| `--autoscale <min:max>` | Enable autoscaling between min and max replicas ("off" to disable) |
| `--install-cmd <cmd>` | Install command (e.g. npm ci) |
| `--build-cmd <cmd>` | Build command |
| `--start-cmd <cmd>` | Start command |
| `--port <n>` | Container port |
| `--health <path>` | Health-check path, e.g. /health |
| `--storage <size>` | Persistent volume size, e.g. 1Gi |
| `-e, --env-var <KEY=VALUE> …` | Environment variable (repeatable) |
| `--env-file <path>` | Load environment variables from a .env file |
| `-s, --secret <KEY=VALUE> …` | Secret variable (repeatable) |
| `--secret-file <path>` | Load secrets from a .env file |
| `--config-file <local[:mount]>` | Mount a local file into the container (e.g. ./app.yaml:/app/config/app.yaml) |
| `-f, --file <path>` | Read settings from a manifest (default: ./nimbuz.json for deploy) |
| `-w, --wait` | Wait until the rollout finishes |

```bash
nimbuz apps create shop-api --repo acme/shop-api --branch main --port 3000 --wait
nimbuz apps create web --repo https://gitlab.com/acme/web.git -i small.m --health /health -e NODE_ENV=production
nimbuz apps create site --archive ./dist.zip --port 80
nimbuz apps create worker --repo acme/jobs --autoscale 1:4 --secret-file .env.secrets
```

**Aliases:** `set`, `edit`, `scale`

| Argument | Description | Required |

| `app` | App name or ID | yes |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-r, --repo <url\|owner/repo>` | Git repository (GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket) |
| `-b, --branch <name>` | Git branch (default: main) |
| `--archive <path>` | Deploy a local .zip/.tar archive instead of Git |
| `--dir <path>` | Sub-folder of the repository to build |
| `--dockerfile <file>` | Dockerfile name (default: auto-detect) |
| `--auto-deploy` | Redeploy automatically on every push |
| `-i, --instance <type>` | Instance type, e.g. nano.m, small.m (see `nimbuz billing pricing`) |
| `--replicas <n>` | Number of replicas |
| `--autoscale <min:max>` | Enable autoscaling between min and max replicas ("off" to disable) |
| `--install-cmd <cmd>` | Install command (e.g. npm ci) |
| `--build-cmd <cmd>` | Build command |
| `--start-cmd <cmd>` | Start command |
| `--port <n>` | Container port |
| `--health <path>` | Health-check path, e.g. /health |
| `--storage <size>` | Persistent volume size, e.g. 1Gi |
| `-e, --env-var <KEY=VALUE> …` | Environment variable (repeatable) |
| `--env-file <path>` | Load environment variables from a .env file |
| `-s, --secret <KEY=VALUE> …` | Secret variable (repeatable) |
| `--secret-file <path>` | Load secrets from a .env file |
| `--config-file <local[:mount]>` | Mount a local file into the container (e.g. ./app.yaml:/app/config/app.yaml) |
| `-f, --file <path>` | Read settings from a manifest (default: ./nimbuz.json for deploy) |
| `-w, --wait` | Wait until the rollout finishes |

```bash
nimbuz apps update shop-api --instance medium.m --replicas 2
nimbuz apps scale shop-api --autoscale 2:6
nimbuz apps update shop-api --branch release/2.0 --wait
```

### `nimbuz logs`

Prints the most recent log lines of an app or tool. Use --build for the latest build's logs and -f to stream.

**Aliases:** `log`

```text
nimbuz logs <name> [flags]
```

| Argument | Description | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | App or tool name | yes |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-f, --follow` | Keep streaming new lines |
| `-n, --tail <n>` | Number of recent lines _(default: 200)_ |
| `--since <15m\|1h\|7d>` | Relative time window _(default: 15m)_ |
| `--from <time>` | Window start (ISO or relative, e.g. 2h) |
| `--to <time>` | Window end (ISO or relative) |
| `-g, --grep <text>` | Only lines containing this text |
| `-b, --build` | Show the latest build's logs |
| `--release <id>` | Show build logs of a specific release |
| `--all` | Print every page in the window (max 10,000 lines) |
| `-z, --timezone <tz>` | IANA time zone for timestamps |
| `--interval <n>` | Seconds between polls with --follow _(default: 5)_ |
| `--raw` | Don't colorize output |

```bash
nimbuz logs shop-api
nimbuz logs shop-api -f --grep error
nimbuz logs shop-api --since 24h --all > shop-api.log
nimbuz logs shop-api --build
nimbuz logs orders-db --since 1h      # tools work too
```

### `nimbuz auth`

Sessions, tokens, 2FA and password

```text
nimbuz auth <command> [flags]
```

**Subcommands:** `login` · `logout` · `status` · `token` · `2fa` · `change-password` · `forgot-password`

---

#### `nimbuz auth login`

Log in with your Nimbuz credentials and save the session locally. Supports two-factor authentication.

```text
nimbuz auth login [flags]
```

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-u, --username <email>` | Username / e-mail |
| `--org <name>` | Business organization name (individual accounts: nimbuz) |
| `--individual` | Log in to an individual account (org = nimbuz) |
| `--password-stdin` | Read the password from stdin (also: NIMBUZ_PASSWORD) |
| `--code <123456>` | 2FA code, if two-factor authentication is enabled |
| `--token <jwt>` | Save an existing access token instead of logging in |

```bash
nimbuz login
nimbuz login --individual -u jane@example.com
nimbuz login --org acme -u jane@acme.com
# CI: read the password from a secret
echo "$NIMBUZ_PASSWORD" | nimbuz login --org acme -u ci@acme.com --password-stdin
```

---

Remove the saved session

### `nimbuz api`

Calls the Nimbuz API gateway with your session and prints the JSON response.
Placeholders {projectId}, {environmentId} and {accountId} are filled from the current context.

```text
nimbuz api <methodOrPath> [path] [flags]
```

| Argument | Description | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `methodOrPath` | HTTP method or path | yes |
| `path` | Path when a method is given | no |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-X, --method <value>` | HTTP method |
| `-d, --data <json\|@file\|->` | JSON request body |
| `-F, --field <key=value> …` | Add a body field (repeatable) |
| `-Q, --query <key=value> …` | Add a query parameter (repeatable) |
| `--scoped` | Add projectId & environmentId query params from the context |
| `--no-auth` | Send without the Authorization header |

```bash
nimbuz api /project/v1/projects
nimbuz api /deployment/v1/deployments/list --scoped
nimbuz api GET /pricing/v1/invoices -Q account_id={accountId} -Q limit=5
nimbuz api PUT /deployment/v1/deployments/<id> -F action=restart -F projectId={projectId} -F environmentId={environmentId}
```

---
